answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to destroy native tokens to validate their status within the nebula of the network. This process functions like a mirror of real-world capital commitment, where an attacker must sacrifice tangible assets to maintain a pulse of influence. Because the cost of burning tokens scales linearly with each fraudulent identity, the economic barrier forces adversaries to choose between massive financial depletion or network exclusion.
